description:
The Azure DevOps Platform Engineer is a member of the Infrastructure Cloud Services team supporting Mosaic’s Azure DevOps and GitHub Enterprise platforms. This role administers platform services, implements secure and reusable CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code standards, and helps teams adopt modern Azure development practices through templates, automation, documentation, and technical guidance. 
 What will you do? 
 Administer Azure DevOps projects, repositories, pipelines, agent pools, permissions, and lifecycle processes. 
 Maintain GitHub Enterprise organization, team, repository, branch protection, and pull request standards. 
 Develop reusable CI/CD, repository, and Infrastructure as Code templates. 
 Support team onboarding through standardized intake processes, checklists, and technical guidance. 
 Implement secure, governed Azure sandbox and non-production environments using automation and Infrastructure as Code. 
 Maintain approved Terraform, Bicep, and related deployment patterns. 
 Assist teams with adopting DevOps practices that meet security, governance, and change-management requirements. 
 Create technical documentation and ServiceNow knowledge articles. 
 Provide training, consultation, and support for Azure DevOps and GitHub users. 
 Monitor platform adoption, compliance, capacity, and improvement opportunities. 
 What do you need for this role? 
 Associate or bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 Two or more years of DevOps platform administration or engineering experience. 
 Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps projects, repositories, permissions, and pipelines. 
 Working knowledge of GitHub Enterprise administration. 
 Familiarity with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or similar Infrastructure as Code technologies. 
 Understanding of CI/CD, source control, branching, pull requests, approvals, and artifact management. 
 Strong communication, documentation, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills.
